raw_text: A Houthi anti-ship ballistic missile struck the bulk carrier True Confidence in the Gulf of Aden on Wednesday, killing three crew members and injuring at least four others in the deadliest attack yet on commercial shipping by the Iran-backed group. The Barbados-flagged, Greek-owned vessel was carrying grain from China to Aden when it was hit approximately 50 nautical miles southwest of the Yemeni port city. The Indian Navy frigate INS Kolkata, operating as part of anti-piracy patrols, assisted in evacuating wounded crew members.
